welcome_page.title: Public transport – How the trip feels
welcome_page.description:
How you feel when you use public transport: mood and worries.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!

questionnaire.title: Public transport – How the trip feels

questions.text: When you use public transport, how stressed or relaxed do you usually feel?
When you use public transport, how often do you feel anxious or overwhelmed?
When you use public transport, what makes you feel anxious or overwhelmed?

options.text: Aggressive or careless drivers, riders or pedestrians
Routes that are complicated or new to me
Not knowing when the bus, tram or train will arrive
Noise, crowds or too much going on around me
Being in a hurry or afraid of being late
Feeling alone or isolated on the way
Health problems on the way (pain, breathlessness, dizziness)

questions.text: When you use public transport, how do you feel on streets with lots of people, shops and activity?

options.text: I prefer them: I feel safer or more at ease
I like them: they make the trip nicer
It makes no difference to me
They are sometimes a bit too much for me
Crowds stress me or make it hard to get through
